description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The Award of the Industrial Dispute which published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2107/31 shall cease to have effect on and after 23.01.2020 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters. It contains a notice regarding the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131), including the declaration that the award will cease to have effect on a specific date. This falls under legal notices, statutory instruments, and regulatory compliance matters related to labor law, which aligns with Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service administration, or judicial appointments.
